chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day"
then he should not spend the night except with witr.

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One in whom faith is affirmed
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this hadith
key_terms.الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ: the Last Day, the Day of Judgment and final return
key_terms.بِوَتْرٍ: with witr, meaning after having performed the witr prayer
key_terms.يَبِيتَنَّ: spends the night or goes to sleep

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teach about sleeping without performing witr?
ai.summary: This hadith urges the believer to conclude the night with the witr prayer, linking this practice to faith in Allah and the Last Day. It emphasizes devotion in worship and readiness before Allah through maintaining the sunnah of nightly prayer.
